candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (pool.size=5, idle=0) across all sampled traces, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeouts and checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time data; saturation inferred from idle=0 and error spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0 on every checkout, propagating to order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and 502s. Order metrics confirm 503s on /v1/orders and postgres save_order errors. Deployment record only establishes order v1.0.0 baseline and does not explain the fault.
